desc:
Welcome to Mymy Clicker! 💗

Click, collect, and become the ultimate Mymy collector! 🖱️✨ Collect Mymy with every click and watch your collection grow!

🐱 Hatch & Collect Pets! - Discover adorable pets that help you earn even MORE Mymy!

⚡ Buy Upgrades! - Boost your clicking power and collect Mymy faster than ever!

💰 Earn & Rebirth! - Get stronger, reset your progress for powerful bonuses, and climb to the top!

🥚 Discover Rare Pets! - Hatch eggs, unlock new companions, and build your dream team!

🏆 Become the Ultimate Mymy Clicker! - Collect as much Mymy as possible and show everyone who's the biggest Mymy fan!

💖 Whether you're a clicker game addict or an Ongezellig fan, there's always more Mymy to collect!

How much Mymy can YOU collect? 👀

👍 Like the game and ⭐ favorite it to support development!
